lessons.claim: The great advantage of the microstructural approach is that the correct objective time derivative comes out automatically -- a near-sphere rotates with the vorticity so the Jaumann (corotational) derivative falls out, and a dumbbell deforms affinely like a material line element so the upper-convected (codeformational) derivative falls out. The continuum approach cannot decide in principle which invariant derivative to use, so Oldroyd-A/B had to be chosen between by experiment
